verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only Requesty's own hosted analytics dashboards for usage, cost, latency and MCP activity, plus a trace_id field used for load-balancing stickiness. Nothing documents exporting logs or traces to an external observability stack (no OpenTelemetry, log drains, or third-party integrations). Built-in dashboards are an adjacent feature, not export, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can export gateway logs and traces to my own observability stack
